title: Michael Faraday's birth chart
metaDescription: Michael Faraday's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 29.4° Virgo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Moon stands at 22.1° Cancer, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 29.4° Virgo, inside the third decan (20°–30°), whose traditional sub-ruler is Venus. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Libra (20.2°), Venus in Scorpio (3.3°), Mars in Leo (7.5°): thought that travels by comparison, attraction that works by atmosphere, effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Mercury to Pluto is the closest call of the day, a trine within 0.0°. The scheme reads trines as water finding its level: effortless, and invisible to the person living it. Behind it, Saturn trine Uranus at 0.6°, and Mars sextile Jupiter at 1.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Sun makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, three placements stand out. The Moon in Cancer at 22.1° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Venus in Scorpio at 3.3° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Saturn in Aries at 16.7° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives air 4, fire 3, water 2, earth 1, and cardinal 5, fixed 4, mutable 1 across the modes. Air runs on comparison and connection — the pattern noticed first, the feeling filed second. Saturn and Pluto were retrograde. Mercury changed direction during the day, so its motion is left open.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Cancer for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.3° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 22.1°.
